body:
Tier: T3
Why: honest money copy. Owner decided 14:39 that coach playbook learning keeps debiting the head coach's AI pool (option A); the AI-usage tutorial must then say that Roman learning the coach's method uses credits (R11-INT-AUD-128 B2, "Playbook metering").
T4 trigger scan: none (copy only; no payment, pool, auth or data path changes).
T3 trigger scan: customer-facing claim about what spends a coach's AI credits.
Bounded T1: NO (customer-facing money claim).
Canonical builder: Claude Opus 5.5 (PB-POOL-128, agent 128)
Parent owner: operator agent 128
Acceptance evidence: src/components/coach/ai-budget/__tests__/AIBudgetTutorialModal.test.tsx: new `it.each` proves card 1 shows the line with purchases shown and hidden (failed before the copy change, 6/6 after); src/__tests__/quietLuxuryDoctrine.test.ts 30/30.
Promotion triggers: any change to how playbook spend is charged (platform payer, different cadence than the 6-hourly build), or a cost figure beyond "a few cents".

## What changes for coaches/clients
- Coaches: the "How AI usage works" card in the AI credits walkthrough now also says: "When Roman learns your coaching method, each refresh uses a few cents of credit, at most four times a day." It appears in both versions of the card (packs shown, and packs hidden on iOS).
- Clients: nothing changes.
- Backend: no PR. trust-pages.html.ts never says what uses AI credits (the privacy page only lists AI-credit balances and spending as stored data), so there is nothing to match there.

## B/U list
- B (R11-INT-AUD-128 B2, option A): a coach with playbook learning on sees credits fall with no text saying why. Fixed: the credits walkthrough says so.
- U: none. C: none.

## Routes/actions before -> after
| label | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| Continue (cards 1-3) | next card | unchanged |
| Pack options $10 / $25 / $99 / Custom (card 4) | onSelectPack(amount) | unchanged |
| I'll buy later (card 4) | persist seen key, onClose | unchanged |
| Done (purchases hidden, last card) | persist seen key, onClose | unchanged |
Parity: copy-only edit to two card bodies; the existing tests still cover continue, later and pack selection (all pass).

## Truthful sweep
- The new line is a conditional rule ("When Roman learns..."), true whether or not FEATURE_ROMAN_PLAYBOOK is on: the backend builds at most every 6 hours (4 a day), each build debits the head coach's pool, and one Sonnet build costs cents. No first person, no exclamation marks, no emojis; no styles touched (theme tokens unchanged).
- README: copy-only change in a component no README describes (no README mentions AIBudgetTutorialModal), so no README update.
